discussion_comments.comment_body: The command is offered on the feature flag alone. A user with no GitHub connection or no GitHub remote only finds out after running it. The workspace manifest already records git URL and branch cheaply at session start, and the cloud service can expose GitHub connection state, so this could be gated up front. Dirty state and `ls-remote` should still be checked at run time.

Keeping `/cloud` visible under the feature flag in this PR. Preparation validates the repository and GitHub access before publication; it does not rely on cached manifest data as authorization. Earlier prerequisite feedback would improve UX, but hiding the command is not required for safe launch. I am deferring that UI change rather than adding another cached eligibility state here.
